strings.frame.layers.tip: Click to select; drag up or down to change the stacking order. Ctrl+Up and Ctrl+Down also move it
strings.frame.mode.tip: Place: drag to move, and drag corners or edges to resize. Crop: drag edges to cut the video
strings.frame.flip.tip: Mirrors the video left to right
strings.frame.allow-outside.tip: Lets the video move beyond the stream screen
strings.frame.crop-mode.tip: Drag the edges to cut the video
strings.frame.reset-crop.tip: Stops cropping and zooming, and shows the whole video
strings.frame.fit.tip: Makes the video as large as fits on the stream screen, keeping its aspect ratio
strings.frame.fill.tip: Makes the video cover the stream screen, keeping its aspect ratio
strings.frame.center.tip: Moves the video to the center of the stream screen without resizing it
strings.frame.forward.tip: Swaps places with the video just in front
strings.frame.backward.tip: Swaps places with the video just behind
strings.frame.front.tip: Shows the video in front of the others
strings.frame.back.tip: Shows the video behind the others
strings.field.english-only: For now, only English letters, numbers, and symbols can be typed.
strings.error.unexpected: Something went wrong and the action could not be completed. Please try again.
strings.preview.label: Stream preview
strings.preview.frame-rate.tip: Stream frame rate. Below the set rate the video looks choppy
strings.preview.exit-fullscreen: Leaves full screen and returns to the normal view
strings.preview.fullscreen-hint: Press Esc or F to return
strings.notice.failure.title: Couldn't complete the action
strings.startup.data-root.title: Can't use the data folder
strings.startup.data-root.body: Virtual Vessel Studio can't write to the data folder. Check the folder location and free space, then start again.
strings.startup.failed.title: Virtual Vessel Studio couldn't start
strings.startup.failed.body: Start it again. If this keeps happening, report it with the logs.
strings.settings.recovered.title: Couldn't read the settings file
strings.settings.recovered.body: Started with the default settings. The original file is kept in the same folder.
strings.settings.save-failed.title: Couldn't save the settings
strings.settings.save-failed.body: Your changes apply until you quit. Check that the settings folder can be written to.
strings.tip.nav.setup: Set up devices and avatars, change app settings, and see the credits of the software in use
strings.tip.nav.diagnostics: Inspect how things are running (for developers)
strings.screen.placeholder: This screen is on its way
strings.settings.title: App settings
strings.settings.motion.description: Stops movement and blinking on screen. With Match Windows settings, they stop when Animation effects is off in Windows.
strings.diagnostics.detailed-off: Detailed metrics: off. Times and values are not recorded
strings.diagnostics.column.name: Name
strings.diagnostics.skeleton.title: Skeleton comparison
strings.diagnostics.skeleton.legend: Solid: what tracking observed. Wide dashes: the avatar, drawn from the tracked shoulders along the avatar's bones with the tracked lengths. They overlap where the directions match. Shown on the avatar's sides, following the mirroring setting.
strings.diagnostics.skeleton.side: Side (from the avatar's right; front to the right)
strings.diagnostics.skeleton.camera.note: While the face's place is not known, the whole image is covered. The image never goes to the stream or a recording.
strings.diagnostics.skeleton.no-body: No body is tracked. Start tracking or replay a recording.
strings.diagnostics.skeleton.left.elevation: Left upper arm, raised above level
strings.diagnostics.skeleton.left.forward: Left upper arm, turned forward from the side
strings.diagnostics.skeleton.right.elevation: Right upper arm, raised above level
strings.diagnostics.skeleton.right.forward: Right upper arm, turned forward from the side
strings.diagnostics.recordings.title: Tracking recordings
strings.diagnostics.recordings.start.during-repl: Recording is not possible during replay
strings.diagnostics.recordings.delete.title: Delete this recording?
strings.diagnostics.recordings.delete.body: A deleted recording cannot be brought back.
strings.diagnostics.recordings.delete-all.title: Delete all recordings?
strings.diagnostics.recordings.delete-all.body: Every recording except one being recorded or replayed is deleted. This cannot be undone.
strings.diagnostics.recordings.note: Recordings hold only numbers, no video. They never leave this PC.
strings.diagnostics.recordings.failed: A recording operation failed. Check the log.
strings.tip.nav.gallery: Check how the shared parts look and work (for developers)
strings.gallery.note: These are samples: using them changes no setting or state
strings.gallery.disabled-reason: Connect a camera to use this
strings.gallery.tooltip-note: Shows after about half a second, and when chosen with the keyboard. It says briefly what a control does, with its shortcut, and why a disabled button can't be used
strings.tip.gallery.sample: Says briefly what a control does
strings.tip.gallery.mic: Turn the microphone on or off
strings.gallery.title: Stream title
strings.gallery.notice-body: It is here to check how notices look
strings.gallery.dialog-body: This is a sample; nothing changes
strings.live.hint: Drag a video to move it and drag its corners to resize it. Right-click for more.
strings.setup.capture.game.title: Capture (game screen)
strings.setup.capture.subscreen.title: Capture (sub monitor)
strings.setup.capture.problem.choose: Choose the capture board under Device. A camera is never opened by itself, so a webcam does not show you by mistake.
strings.setup.capture.problem.signal: No video is arriving. Check the game device's power and cable.
strings.setup.capture.problem.notfound: It is found again by itself when connected.
strings.setup.capture.problem.failed: Another app may be using the device.
strings.setup.capture.problem.inuse: Tracking uses this camera. Choose another device.
strings.setup.tracking.title: Tracking
strings.setup.tracking.problem.choose: Choose the webcam to track with in Camera.
strings.setup.tracking.problem.notfound: The camera is not found. It is found again when you connect it.
strings.setup.tracking.problem.inuse: The game screen capture uses this camera. Choose another camera.
strings.setup.tracking.problem.failed: The camera could not open or tracking could not start. Check that no other app is using the camera.
strings.setup.tracking.problem.noperson: Sit in front of the camera so your face and upper body are in view.
strings.setup.avatar.title: Avatar
strings.setup.avatar.filetitle: Choose the avatar file to register
strings.setup.avatar.problem.notvrm: This is not a VRM file. Choose a file ending in .vrm.
strings.setup.avatar.problem.toolarge: The file is too large. Choose a file of 1 GB or less.
strings.setup.avatar.problem.missingbones: This model cannot be used because its humanoid bones are incomplete.
strings.setup.avatar.problem.loadfailed: The avatar could not be loaded. Check that the file is not damaged.
strings.setup.avatar.problem.storage: Could not save. Check the free space at the save location.
strings.setup.avatar.confirm.title: Register this avatar?
strings.setup.avatar.confirm.body: Check the terms of use set by the author before registering.
strings.setup.avatar.confirm.notice: This model is not set to be usable as an avatar by everyone. Check the terms of use to see whether you may use it.
strings.setup.avatar.remove.title: Unregister this avatar?
strings.setup.avatar.remove.body: The copy of the model in this app is deleted. Your original file is kept.
strings.setup.avatar.license.title: Terms of use (set by the model's author)
strings.setup.avatar.license.name: Model name
strings.setup.avatar.license.permission: Who may use it as an avatar
strings.setup.avatar.value.modificationredistrib: Allowed, including redistributing what you changed
strings.setup.credits.title: Credits and licenses
strings.setup.credits.intro: Virtual Vessel Studio uses the following software and assets. Where the full license text is included, open it with "Show full text".
strings.setup.credits.unavailable: The credits could not be read. Reinstalling the app may fix this.
strings.setup.credits.missing: The full license text is missing.
strings.setup.tracking.depth.description: 2D leaves out moving toward and away from the camera and moves the avatar only as seen from the front. The arms point more steadily.
strings.setup.tracking.speed.description: Higher follows your movement faster; lower keeps the avatar steadier.
strings.setup.tracking.range.description: For streaming seated. Full body is coming later.
strings.setup.tracking.parts.description: Turning off parts you do not use lowers the load. A part turned off does not move.
strings.setup.tracking.model.description: Light uses less of the computer but tracks the body more roughly. A change takes a few seconds to get ready again.
strings.setup.tracking.front.description: If the camera is to one side, face your usual front and click Face the front, so the avatar faces forward.
strings.setup.tracking.front.right: Front: {degrees}° to the right of the camera
strings.setup.tracking.front.left: Front: {degrees}° to the left of the camera
strings.setup.tracking.front.unseen: The front could not be set. Turn tracking on, and click while you are in view of the camera.
strings.setup.face.title: Face tuning
strings.setup.face.intro: With tracking running, watch the avatar while you adjust. Higher values show an expression with less movement. Under each slider is how far the avatar moves now.
strings.setup.face.light.description: This also changes the light on the stream, and is saved.
strings.setup.face.winks.description: When on, one eye can close alone. Turn it off if one eye closes by mistake, such as when you turn your head.
